name: CO2 Impact
summary: UK carbon reporting software for small and mid-sized businesses: emissions from bills and uploads across Scope 1, 2 and 3, a carbon reduction plan, SECR reports and optional automated meter data.
best_for: UK small and mid-sized businesses that need a first carbon footprint, Scope 1-3 reporting or a carbon reduction plan for customers and tenders, without hiring a consultant
skip_if: you want to test the reports before committing for a year (the page shows no free trial), you need multi-country group reporting, or you already work with a sustainability consultancy that supplies its own tools
honest_knock: Every licence is a 12-month commitment, and the page shows no free trial and no add-on prices, so extra users, sites or meter feeds have to be asked for. The page does not say whether VAT is included, and the table changed since our October reads (Basic £468 a year then, Essentials £369 now), so check it before you pay. We have not used CO2 Impact ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per year (£30.75/mo) for 2 users and 2 sites
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-19 in the pricing section of co2impact.co.uk's homepage, GBP; the vendor's own llms.txt lists the same three plans) Essentials is £369 a year (£30.75 a month) for 2 users and 2 sites. Professional is £749 a year (£62.42 a month) for 10 users and 5 sites. Enterprise is £1,899 a year (£158.25 a month) for unlimited users and unlimited sites. Prices are shown as billed annually, and each plan is a 12-month licence. Every plan lists the web platform (manual or Excel upload), the mobile app, bill and receipt forwarding by email, a ChatGPT plugin, full Scope 1, 2 and 3 reporting, a carbon reduction plan and multiple emission reports by activity; Professional adds SECR reporting and Metrics. The page does not say whether VAT is included, and it shows no add-on prices and no free trial. Our reads of 9 and 22 October 2026 showed a different table (Basic £468 a year, Professional £599, Premium £729, Platinum £1,199); we do not know why it changed.

schema_offer.description: Basic, £468 paid annually + VAT, shown as £39.00 per month + VAT; 12-month commitment; 1 user and 1 operational site. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-22.

compare_with.name: a carbon consultancy
compare_with.why: a consultancy delivers the footprint and reduction plan for you at day rates; CO2 Impact is software you fill yourself from bills and uploads, at a fixed yearly price per user and site, with consultancy at £75 an hour if you need help
